thread:
alina: Heads up team, change window starts in 45m. Activating launch freeze now. Short checklist in-thread, reply when done:
- pin canary to v2.4.1
- disable nonessential batch jobs
- run 10m smoke (50 reqs)
- set alert thresholds and rollback command ready
- don't publish release notes until freeze lifted

samir: Pinning canary now. Will post when complete.

deploy-bot: [action] POST /pins -> env=canary model=v2.4.1 result=ok id=pin-202503 :white_check_mark:

maria: Starting smoke (50 reqs across core endpoints).

ken: Proposing rollback triggers: error rate >4% for 3m OR p95 latency >750ms for 5m. Auto-rollback disabled; we use automated alerts + manual confirm. Rollback target v2.3.7.

alina: Sounds good. Manual abort remains with release lead (me). Documented in canary runbook.

ops-oncall: Pager rules updated. Added Grafana alert for both conditions. I'll be on watch.

samir: Disabled ingest-batch and nightly-index crons in prod.

devops-bot: `cron disable ingest-batch nightly-index` executed -> success.

maria: Canary warmup metrics look stable, CPU/mem within baselines. Beginning smoke run.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted -> 5% (stable checkpoint).

alina: OK. If stable for 8m we'll move to 20%. Reminder: DO NOT merge release notes until freeze lifted.

ken: Rollback playbook quick steps added: 1) scale canary replicas to 0, 2) run `/rollback-service --env canary --to v2.3.7`, 3) set traffic=0, 4) verify logs and metrics. Notify #postmortems after action.

ops-oncall: Copy. I have a short watch script tailing p95 and error rate, will page on breach.

maria: Smoke 10m done, no regressions on auth or embeddings. Ready for 20%.

samir: Approving traffic increase.

deploy-bot: Traffic set -> 20% (steady).

alina: Good. We'll sit at 20% for 20m then consider full rollout. Keep communications terse here.

maria: Minor hiccup: embed-worker queue briefly spiked to 60% but drained in ~90s, no errors logged. Monitoring.

samir: Paused a heavy ML-job that could thump infra during rollout.

devops-bot: Reminder snippet: `rollback command: /rollback-service --env prod --to v2.3.7 && unpin model v2.4.1`

alina: Thanks. Thumbs up if watching charts. :thumbsup:

ken: :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Watching now, will escalate if triggers fire.

maria: 20% stable at +12m. Proceeding to warmup for wider rollout.

samir: Standing by for the final go/no-go.

alina: Final note: make sure release notes PR is held in draft and changelog entry is not merged until freeze lifted. If rollback occurs, we'll add an incident note to the release branch.
